fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The top level response error code.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.about: The fetch session ID, or 0 if this is not part of a fetch session.

fields.name: Responses
fields.about: The response topics.

fields.name: Topic
fields.about: The topic name.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The topic partitions.

fields.name: PartitionIndex
fields.about: The partition index.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no fetch error.

fields.name: HighWatermark
fields.about: The current high water mark.

fields.name: LastStableOffset
fields.about: The last stable offset (or LSO) of the partition. This is the last offset such that the state of all transactional records prior to this offset have been decided (ABORTED or COMMITTED).

fields.name: LogStartOffset
fields.about: The current log start offset.

fields.name: DivergingEpoch
fields.about: In case divergence is detected based on the `LastFetchedEpoch` and `FetchOffset` in the request, this field indicates the largest epoch and its end offset such that subsequent records are known to diverge.

fields.name: Epoch
fields.about: The largest epoch.

fields.name: EndOffset
fields.about: The end offset of the epoch.

fields.name: CurrentLeader
fields.about: The current leader of the partition.

fields.name: LeaderId
fields.about: The ID of the current leader or -1 if the leader is unknown.

fields.name: LeaderEpoch
fields.about: The latest known leader epoch.

fields.name: SnapshotId
fields.about: In the case of fetching an offset less than the LogStartOffset, this is the end offset and epoch that should be used in the FetchSnapshot request.

fields.name: EndOffset
fields.about: The end offset of the epoch.

fields.name: Epoch
fields.about: The largest epoch.

fields.name: AbortedTransactions
fields.about: The aborted transactions.

fields.name: ProducerId
fields.about: The producer id associated with the aborted transaction.

fields.name: FirstOffset
fields.about: The first offset in the aborted transaction.

fields.name: PreferredReadReplica
fields.about: The preferred read replica for the consumer to use on its next fetch request.

fields.name: Records
fields.about: The record data.

fields.name: NodeEndpoints
fields.about: Endpoints for all current-leaders enumerated in PartitionData, with errors NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER & FENCED_LEADER_EPOCH.

fields.name: NodeId
fields.about: The ID of the associated node.

fields.name: Host
fields.about: The node's hostname.

fields.name: Port
fields.about: The node's port.

fields.name: Rack
fields.about: The rack of the node, or null if it has not been assigned to a rack.
